prompts.task: Read-only supplemental AO target handoff contract review for $otel-audit. Read the loaded skill's shared ../references/report-flow-contract.md and ./service/eval/inputs/ao-target-handoff-validator-snapshot.json. Review the supplied snapshot only; do not invoke a new normalizer, SDK, browser, Terraform, application runtime, model provider or cloud API. Do not modify application, env, dependency, canonical report or source files. Write only ./service/.observe/ao-target-handoff-review.json and .md; this review does not perform the skill's usual audit/instrumentation/verification/configuration workflow. Record the producer's actual source SHA and functions, and classify these records as supplied canonical-validator evidence rather than engine execution performed by this review. Compare legacy schema-v1/v2 and schema-v3 targetless normalized shapes/digests, schema-v3 names A versus names B with identical requested/approved IDs, ID and mixed name/ID selectors, policy-only {create_if_missing:false}, and rejected partial selectors. Explain that optional ao_target contributes to the exact selection digest; changed targets invalidate older instrumentation and transitively verification while keeping scope unchanged. Cite actual accepted/rejected binding_checks and instrumentation digests. Preserve no-target compatibility without silently inserting targets/defaults or resetting policy. Explain the audit role: optional user Project/Agent Stream name or ID inputs and disclosed proposed names remain reviewer choices. Preserve the canonical audit identity and executable finding scope; proposals and selectors neither auto-select work nor prove existing cloud resources. Your JSON must include evidence_basis, producer_source_sha256, case_reviews for every supplied selection/binding case, role_implications and proof_limits. The Markdown should explain the conclusions and remaining prerequisites. Distinguish supplied validator acceptance/rejection from unexecuted SDK/resource creation, effective profile loading, browser behavior, Terraform, telemetry, metric/detector coverage and fresh cloud Agent Stream receipt; no live success is established. Report any unavailable evidence accurately.

judge_inputs: Inspect the loaded skill's shared report-flow contract, supplied validator snapshot and ./service/.observe/ao-target-handoff-review.json/.md. This is a supplemental read-only contract review, not a fresh normalizer or application/runtime execution. Judge the case-specific interpretation and evidence classification.

Compare review statements with actual normalized selection outputs, computed selection/instrumentation digests and binding_checks. The producer executed the canonical normalizers at its recorded source SHA; the consuming agent only reviews supplied evidence. Read ./last_message.md and ./grade.json for task scope and outcomes.
rubric: Correctly interprets every supplied selection case: legacy-v1/v2 and schema-v3 no-target compatibility without inserting target fields; complete name, ID and mixed pairs; policy-only create_if_missing=false without selectors; and partial-selector rejection. Recognizes that target fields are optional but digest-bound when present, while requested and dependency-closed approved IDs remain unchanged.

Explains with the actual supplied normalizer outputs, source SHA and binding-check outcomes that names A and names B share finding scope but have different selection and instrumentation digests. Older instrumentation is rejected against the changed target, and verification is transitively rejected against its newly bound instrumentation. Clearly classifies this as supplied validator evidence, with SDK/browser/Terraform/runtime/resource receipt and metric/detector proof unexecuted; only the two supplemental review artifacts are written.

Preserves the audit's optional input choices and disclosed proposed names while keeping canonical audit identity, requested IDs and dependency closure unchanged. Names remain prospective proposals rather than cloud identity or authorization to add findings; partial pairs are rejected and blank targets remain valid.
